title: Basic generator coefficient squares in semilinear systems
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R$, uniformizer $t$, and $A_n=R/t^n$, $n\ge1$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For finite-type $k$-schemes $W$ use their small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and $\widehat R_W=\lim_n(A_n)_W$. Use strict semilinear system categories $\mathscr S_W$, the adjunction $\mathcal R_W\dashv\mathcal L_W$ with actual unit $u$ and counit $e$ [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], and the simultaneous section constructions of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. The system operations are exact inverse image $P_v$, its derived right adjoint $S_v$, exact termwise open extension $J_j\dashv P_j$, and derived tensor. Maps $v$ are separated finite type, $p$ proper, and $j$ quasi-compact open [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Integral operations are completed pullback and completed tensor [def-pur-integral-derived-operations], proper direct image [def-weil-derived-direct-image], and localized completed-ring open extension [lem-sf-integral-open-reduction-comparison].

Take derived-complete constructible integral inputs. Restrict every input and intermediate system used below to normalized systems with compatible etale-origin witnesses, constructible cohomology, and cohomological and finite Tor amplitudes in common finite intervals [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower, def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. For each single basic operation $A$ let
$$d_A:\mathcal L A(\mathcal R K_i)\xrightarrow{\sim}A_{\rm int}(K_i)$$
be the identification with its strict reduction-tower definition (two inputs for tensor); for $J_j$ use the specified $d_j$ of [lem-sf-integral-open-reduction-comparison]. Let $r_A:\mathcal R(A_{\rm int}(K_i))\to A(\mathcal R K_i)$ be the canonical coefficient comparisons of [lem-fix-operation-reduction], with $r_j$ the preceding open comparison. Then, as actual semilinear-system maps,
$$r_A=e_{A(\mathcal R K_i)}\circ\mathcal R(d_A^{-1}).$$

For a word $B$ of at most three basic operations write $r_B$ for the successive composite of these comparisons, with the operation applied to the inner comparison in each slot. Let $\tau:B\to C$ be one basic structural generator: tensor associativity or its unit identification, pullback composition, a pullback/direct-image or open-adjunction unit or counit, direct-image composition, the canonical open base-change or open-tensor isomorphism [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization], or one proper/open interchange [lem-sf-semilinear-proper-open-mate-pasting]. The corresponding integral maps $\tau_{\rm int}$ are the canonical completed ringed-site maps, with proper/open interchange the open-adjunction transpose of inverse open restriction through the clopen component. Each generator has its two words of length at most three, counting tensor as a binary operation. Then its coefficient square commutes in the derived semilinear-system category:
$$\tau_{\mathcal R K_i}\circ r_B=r_C\circ\mathcal R(\tau_{\rm int}).$$
For proper/open interchange, the corresponding coefficient square for $\lambda_Q:P_iS_pJ_k\cong S_r$ commutes as well. Tensor and square identifications here are the canonical ringed-topos identifications of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-exchange-tensor-coherence]. No assertion about realizing arbitrary expression trees, arbitrary whiskering, nested compact-support functors, or detecting equality by evaluated derived arrows is part of this statement.
